The text is too faint to read comfortably for people with low vision or impaired contrast perception. **Who it affects** Anyone with moderately low vision or reduced contrast sensitivity—including people with age-related vision changes or color vision deficiencies—will struggle to read this announcement about the riverfront path closure. **The fix** Darken the gray color to meet the 4.5:1 threshold. Change the foreground color from `rgb(138, 138, 138)` to something like `rgb(89, 89, 89)`: ```html

The riverfront path will be closed between Mill St and 4th Ave until 12 April.

``` Or update the `.muted` class rule in your stylesheet: ```css .muted { color: rgb(89, 89, 89); } ``` The light background (`rgb(242, 242, 242)`) stays the same.
